title: dioman 洋葱管线 B5b 删除与切换报告
status: active
updated: 2026-10-29
summary: 唯一入口与目录归位、旧实现删除、新 API 执行器和示例、785 项台账和 631 行总账、覆盖率与闸门证据
---

## 结果

- 唯一入口为 `package:dioman/dioman.dart`，新实现平铺至 lib/src（保留 plugins/）。27/27 源码与 B5a 工作区 SHA256 一致，与 895d959 规范化换行后也一致；没有修改库行为。
- 全仓 `dart analyze` 和 `dart analyze example` 均 0 issue；含分支覆盖的全量 `dart test` 5014 条全绿。24 个可执行文件行/分支均 100%；3 个声明文件无执行分母。
- G0/G1/G2/G3/G5 均零缺口，G1 白名单 4 → 0；G4 剩 190 个待 B7 缺口，已逐条分类，包含 connect 超时 BLOCKED。
- API 台账 693 → 785；总账 442 → 631；基线 2 → 190，仅增加 G4。未运行 testkit 全量。
- 无 commit/push/切分支。除要求的 codex review 命令外未转派。临时 bench worktree 已移除，没有修改其它工作区。

## 1. 删除前留存

[旧版 key 原始导出](pipeline-b5b-evidence/key-export-raw.json) 在删除前实际同时调用新旧实现，固定种子 2400 组逐项相等后输出。[固定基准](../../test/support/key_baseline.json) 含全部输入对应结果。409 项包含进程相关 identityHashCode，不能原样跨进程比较，故该数值槽固定为 `<identityHashCode(data)>`；测试只在此槽代入当前请求体身份，其余字节严格对照。这个差异在第一次跨进程全量复跑中发现并修正，原始未替换导出也保留供核对。第二条开关/异常/NaN 用例原本就是新服务规则断言，继续保留。见 [导出时差分](pipeline-b5b-evidence/key-export.txt)、[固定基准复跑](pipeline-b5b-evidence/key-baseline-test.txt)。

旧 bench 改为 `python tool/bench_legacy.py --out <结果.json>`：固定 895d959，用唯一临时目录执行 `git worktree add --detach`，在其中 dioman 子包跑旧 S1–S6，finally 移除且校验移除目录在授权工作区中。Git 根比包高一级，初次探测因目录层级失败后已修正；正式一轮退出 0，六场景完成。新版 `dart run benchmark/pipeline.dart` 也实际跑通一轮。两版共用 runner 格式，只验证可运行，不对性能数字下结论。

[旧结果](pipeline-b5b-evidence/bench-legacy.json)、[旧日志](pipeline-b5b-evidence/bench-legacy-stderr.txt)、[新结果](pipeline-b5b-evidence/bench-pipeline.json)。B6 轮流执行旧命令与新命令各三轮即可交错 A/B。

## 2. 删除清单

删除前已保存 [逐文件清单](pipeline-b5b-evidence/deleted.txt)。fixtures.dart、fake_cache_persist.dart、test_server.dart 均无新代码引用，全部删除；新真实回环用例在各自测试内创建 HttpServer。所有删除均直接删除，未 git rm。

## 4. 执行器改动

- 删除 EnvelopeTransformer、业务码 shouldRetry/shouldTrip、auth onFailure 信封适配、总预算错误改写拦截器、额外拆包和旧取消插件 track/untrack。失败不再按 extra 标签或 DioException 内容重新解释。
- 被测请求使用 api.send；DiomanCall 与类型化 option 键承担请求配置。归类只读 DiomanResponse.kind/reason/status；刷新回调用独立新客户端拿数据，不替库增加归一化能力。pending_after 读取 api.pending。
- 保留真实网络探测、multipart 构造、限流停止守卫与事件记录。mock-in-chain 已登记；raw-business-code 未声明，requires 指定该能力时输出 `skipped: missing raw-business-code`。testkit 侧补能力名仍留 B7。`total_ms` 无库原生实现，已从接受字段删除并显式拒绝该配置；执行器不再用宿主计时器补能力。
- 未声明网络/风格和场景 skip 从字段读取，原因以“不适用：”开头；没有新增按场景 id 黑名单。原维度排除集合不变，仅统一前缀；两类跳过已有离线执行器回归。
- 旧 API 大探针替换为新客户端真实 ping 与实际字段读取，未执行的 API 不伪报触达，B7 按新台账继续补真实证据。

## 终审修复与 codex review

无库行为修复。切换工具修正了 key 身份哈希基准跨进程复跑、bench 临时包层级、常量标题反查和符号扫描泛型吞函数声明；后两项有独立回归。

`codex review --uncommitted` 已正常结束，exit 0，提出 3 个成立 P2，全部修复。完整原文见 [review](pipeline-b5b-evidence/codex-review.txt)。

1. business 429/503 服务停止守卫丢失：只在库工厂已归一化结果上读取 status/data，服务停止时标记 serviceBlocked 并中止；不判定原始业务码，不改响应，不补 retry/breaker 能力。注入 HTTP/business 503 仍交原生重试。回归确认非注入状态只发送一次。
2. total_ms 被接受却不执行：明确拒绝不支持的字段，删除“接受但无效”的配置路径，不恢复宿主总预算计时器。
3. send 不抛预期失败，示例 catch 不可达：要抛错的示例改 request；其它继续读 send 返回值。新增真实回环服务执行完整 CLI 示例，确认预期 404 后继续至 ALL CHECKS PASSED。该回归还发现 debug 不是每次普通请求自动输出日志，示例改为验证失败调用栈及显式诊断输出。

[修复后执行器回归](pipeline-b5b-evidence/review-regressions.txt)、[完整 CLI 回环回归](pipeline-b5b-evidence/example-regression.txt)。[逐项撤掉修复](pipeline-b5b-evidence/review-reverse.json) 均产生 1 条运行时失败，之后恢复最终源码；没有用编译失败冒充回归。

## 终审修复：公共面收口（最终口径）

本节取代上文初次 B5b 的“785 项 API / 631 行总账 / 27 文件覆盖率”作为最终发版口径；上文增删公式和初次审查保留为过程记录。

问题：内部取消桥、共享状态和物理表诊断进入公共 barrel 和台账，形成了不应承诺的发布契约。逐项核对原台账全部 785 项，最终保留 746 项、内部化 39 项，无新增公共项。完整逐项决定与理由见 [785 项审计](pipeline-b5b-evidence/final-review-api-audit.json)，最终全部声明、成员和参数见 [746 项公开清单](pipeline-b5b-evidence/final-review-public-api.json)。

修法：`DiomanContextState`、`DiomanCancelLink` 移入未导出的 `src/context_state.dart`。上下文保存私有 `_state`，公开构造器不接收内部状态；内核通过 `DiomanContextInternal.create` 注入状态，派生继续共享。状态访问和诊断位于未直接导出的同库 `context_internal.dart`、`client_internal.dart`、`plugins/cache_internal.dart`、`plugins/share_internal.dart`，由扩展读取私有字段；测试显式导入未导出的 `package:dioman/src/diagnostics.dart`。缓存公开管理端口仅保留 remove/clear；共享诊断标记与其扩展均不从公共入口导出。无依赖新增，没有使用 @internal/meta。

公共 barrel 对所有源文件使用 show 白名单，执行器注册/校验/排序/编译、内置阶段表和内核传输函数也不再导出。测试仍直接验证 I3 订阅、共享保留状态、屏障、条目和活动表清空；未删行为断言。公开声明可达性测试删去五个内部声明的公共可达性断言，另补公共构造器隔离/取消回归及 SDK 编译级负向用例：16 个内部名称、5 个白盒 getter 均不可经公共 barrel 访问。

### 收口的完整 39 项

- `INV-context-lifecycle`（22 项）：内部取消与逻辑状态生命周期，插件作者使用 wait/cancelled/get/set/markReplayable；共享状态本体及诊断不构成公共契约。

`Dioman.cancellationSubscriptions`, `DiomanCancelLink`, `DiomanCancelLink.new`, `DiomanCancelLink.new(source)`, `DiomanCancelLink.new(target)`, `DiomanCancelLink.dispose`, `DiomanContextState`, `DiomanContextState.new`, `DiomanContextState.new(token)`, `DiomanContextState.new(onDispose)`, `DiomanContextState.token`, `DiomanContextState.values`, `DiomanContextState.keys`, `DiomanContextState.listeners`, `DiomanContextState.replayable`, `DiomanContextState.retain`, `DiomanContextState.release`, `DiomanContextState.cancel`, `DiomanContextState.dispose`, `DiomanContext.new(state)`, `DiomanContext.state`, `DiomanContext.cancellationSubscriptions`。

- `INV-pipeline-internals`（13 项）：内核安装、排序、编译与传输实现；自定义插件经 setup/handle/next 接入。

- `INV-source-diagnostics`（4 项）：物理屏障、缓存条目和共享活动表诊断，仅供白盒验证资源回收。

### 最终公共面与保留理由

`replaceOption` 保留标量覆盖策略；`resolveOption` 保留省略/true 沿用、false 关闭、optIn 及类型化合并/简写校验契约。`DiomanOptionKey` 按实例身份隔离插件选项，`StateKey` 按实例身份隔离逻辑请求状态，插件作者应使用稳定的非 const 键实例。`DiomanContext` 的 get/set、derive、wait、cancelled、markReplayable 等供自定义插件读取、派生、等待和声明重放；`DiomanPlugin`/`DiomanPluginInstance`/`DiomanNext`、阶段枚举与请求/响应工厂保留扩展契约。

`Dioman.pending` 是宿主管理活跃逻辑调用的语义计数；`DiomanLoadingApi.activeCount` 是宿主界面可消费的 loading 参与数；`DiomanOfflineApi.pending/flush` 和 `DiomanBreakerApi.state/reset` 是宿主队列/断路器管理端口，均保留。`defaultAuthFailure` 是可复用的默认认证策略。它们与内部物理表大小有明确用途差异，逐项理由已登记到审计文件。

Application     dart.bat                                           0.0.0.0    E:\sdk\flutter\bin\dart.bat
import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'clock.dart';
import 'config.dart';
import 'context.dart';
import 'context_state.dart';
import 'key.dart';
import 'options.dart';
import 'pipeline.dart';
import 'plugin.dart';
import 'request.dart';
import 'response.dart';
import 'stages.dart';
import 'transport.dart';

part 'client_internal.dart';

/// 关闭 debug 时复用的空日志器。
void _noLog(String _) {}

/// 以 Dio 为引擎的洋葱管线客户端；旧入口与本库完全独立。
class Dioman<R extends DiomanResponse<dynamic>> {
  /// 创建客户端，例如 `Dioman(dio: Dio(), debug: true)`。
  /// [response] 控制归一化，[reject] 只转换动词方法的可预期失败。
  Dioman(
      {required this.dio,
      List<DiomanPlugin<R>> plugins = const [],
      DiomanResponseFactory<R>? response,
      this.key = const DiomanKeyOptions(),
      this.reject,
      Object? debug,
      this.clock = const DiomanClock.system()})
      : response = response ?? DiomanResponseFactory<R>(),
        _debug = debug != null && debug != false,
        _logger =
            debug is DiomanLogger ? debug : (debug == true ? print : _noLog) {
    if (debug != null && debug is! bool && debug is! DiomanLogger) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(debug, 'debug');
    }
    validateDiomanPlugins(plugins);
    try {
      for (final plugin in plugins) {
        _registrations.add(DiomanRegistration(
            plugin, plugin.enabled ? plugin.setup(this) : null));
      }
      _compile();
    } catch (_) {
      for (final registration in _registrations.reversed) {
        try {
          registration.instance?.dispose();
        } catch (_) {/* 保留安装时首次异常。 */}
      }
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  /// 底层 Dio；用户拦截器在每次传输时运行。
  final Dio dio;

  /// 客户端的归一化服务。
  final DiomanResponseFactory<R> response;

  /// 客户端构键配置。
  final DiomanKeyOptions key;

  /// 可预期失败的最终异常转换器。
  final Object Function(R)? reject;

  /// 可注入时间服务。
  final DiomanClock clock;

  /// 是否记录调用点。
  final bool _debug;

  /// 用户日志器或默认输出。
  final DiomanLogger _logger;

  /// 注册顺序，供生命周期和 extend 使用。
  final _registrations = <DiomanRegistration<R>>[];

  /// 已排序的执行层快照。
  List<DiomanRegistration<R>> _layers = [];

  /// 编译后的链，在途请求捕获当前值。
  late DiomanRunner<R> _run;

  /// 活跃逻辑请求。
  final _pending = <DiomanContextState>{};

  /// 仍可取消的请求状态，包含逻辑调用已结束的共享传输。
  final _cancellable = <DiomanContextState>{};

  /// 请求序号。
  int _sequence = 0;

  /// 生命周期状态。
  bool _disposed = false;

  /// 当前活跃逻辑请求数。
  int get pending => _pending.length;

  /// 隔离日志回调异常，避免 debug 改变请求结果。
  void _log(String message) {
    try {
      _logger(message);
    } catch (_) {/* 日志通知不影响请求。 */}
  }

  /// 记录插件通知故障；[message] 交给用户日志器或默认输出，日志器异常会隔离。
  /// 例如插件捕获回调错误后调用 `client.logError('通知失败')`，不受 debug 开关抑制。
  void logError(String message) {
    if (_debug) {
      _log(message);
    } else {
      try {
        print(message);
      } catch (_) {/* 输出通知不影响请求。 */}
    }
  }

  /// 拒绝销毁后的操作。
  void _checkAlive() {
    if (_disposed) throw StateError('客户端已销毁');
  }

  /// 在配置变动时编译链，不在请求期间排序。
  void _compile() {
    _layers = sortDiomanPipeline(_registrations);
    _run = compileDiomanPipeline(_layers, (ctx) => diomanTransport(dio, ctx));
  }

  /// 添加插件；先校验再 setup，安装失败不修改当前链。
  void use(DiomanPlugin<R> plugin) {
    _checkAlive();
    validateDiomanPlugins([..._registrations.map((r) => r.plugin), plugin]);
    final instance = plugin.enabled ? plugin.setup(this) : null;
    _registrations.add(DiomanRegistration(plugin, instance));
    _compile();
  }

  /// 按 [name] 移除并释放插件；不存在返回 false，在途保留原链。
  bool eject(String name) {
    final index = _registrations.indexWhere((r) => r.plugin.name == name);
    if (index < 0) return false;
    final removed = _registrations.removeAt(index);
    _compile();
    removed.instance?.dispose();
    return true;
  }

  /// 返回实现 [A] 的第一个实例，例如 `api.plugin<CacheApi>()`。
  A? plugin<A>() {
    for (final r in _registrations) {
      if (r.instance is A) return r.instance as A;
    }
    return null;
  }

  /// 返回解析后的固定阶段和名称顺序，返回列表不可修改。
  List<(DiomanStage, String)> inspect() => List.unmodifiable(_layers.map((r) {
        final fixed = diomanBuiltinStages.entries
            .where((e) => e.value.contains(r.plugin.name));
        return (
          fixed.isEmpty ? r.plugin.stage : fixed.single.key,
          r.plugin.name
        );
      }));

  /// 中止尚未取消的请求状态（含保留的共享传输），返回本次中止数。
  int cancelAll([Object? reason]) {
    var count = 0;
    for (final state in _cancellable.toList()) {
      if (!state.token.isCancelled) {
        count++;
        state.cancel(reason);
      }
    }
    return count;
  }

  /// 克隆 BaseOptions 并重新 setup 插件，状态不共享；[plugins] 替换继承列表。
  /// [options] 在 setup 后合并非空、非默认字段，显式覆盖优先；容器按键合并。
  /// BaseOptions 不记录省略信息，不能用默认值重置已有非默认值。
  /// 例如 `api.extend(options: BaseOptions(baseUrl: 'https://child.example'))`。
  Dioman<R> extend({BaseOptions? options, List<DiomanPlugin<R>>? plugins}) {
    _checkAlive();
    final child = Dioman<R>(
        dio: Dio(cloneDiomanOptions(dio.options)),
        plugins: plugins ?? _registrations.map((r) => r.plugin).toList(),
        response: response,
        key: key,
        reject: reject,
        debug: _debug ? _logger : false,
        clock: clock);
    if (options != null) mergeDiomanOptions(child.dio.options, options);
    return child;
  }

  /// 先取消请求，再逆序释放全部实例；清理完毕后原栈抛出首个异常。
  void dispose() {
    if (_disposed) return;
    _disposed = true;
    cancelAll();
    final errors = <(Object, StackTrace)>[];
    for (final r in _registrations.reversed) {
      try {
        r.instance?.dispose();
      } catch (e, s) {
        errors.add((e, s));
      }
    }
    if (errors.isNotEmpty) {
      Error.throwWithStackTrace(errors.first.$1, errors.first.$2);
    }
  }

  /// 执行请求并返回结果；可预期失败不抛，internal 原异常原栈抛出。
  /// 例如 `await api.send<Object?>('GET', '/pets')`。
  Future<DiomanResponse<T>> send<T>(String method, String path,
      {Map<String, dynamic>? query, Object? data, DiomanCall? call}) async {
    final result =
        await _dispatch(method, path, query: query, data: data, call: call);
    if (result is DiomanResponse<T>) return result;
    return result.copy<T>();
  }

  /// 执行任意 [method] 并返回数据；可预期失败经 reject 后抛出。
  Future<T> request<T>(String method, String path,
      {Map<String, dynamic>? query, Object? data, DiomanCall? call}) async {
    final result =
        await _dispatch(method, path, query: query, data: data, call: call);
    if (!result.ok) throw (reject?.call(result as R) ?? result);
    return result.data as T;
  }

  /// 发送 GET 并返回数据；参数与 request 相同，例如 `api.get<Object?>('/pets')`。
  Future<T> get<T>(String path,
          {Map<String, dynamic>? query, Object? data, DiomanCall? call}) =>
      request<T>('GET', path, query: query, data: data, call: call);

  /// 发送 POST 并返回数据；参数与 request 相同，例如 `api.post<Object?>('/pets')`。
  Future<T> post<T>(String path,
          {Map<String, dynamic>? query, Object? data, DiomanCall? call}) =>
      request<T>('POST', path, query: query, data: data, call: call);

  /// 发送 PUT 并返回数据；参数与 request 相同，例如 `api.put<Object?>('/pets')`。
  Future<T> put<T>(String path,
          {Map<String, dynamic>? query, Object? data, DiomanCall? call}) =>
      request<T>('PUT', path, query: query, data: data, call: call);

  /// 发送 PATCH 并返回数据；参数与 request 相同，例如 `api.patch<Object?>('/pets')`。
  Future<T> patch<T>(String path,
          {Map<String, dynamic>? query, Object? data, DiomanCall? call}) =>
      request<T>('PATCH', path, query: query, data: data, call: call);

  /// 发送 DELETE 并返回数据；参数与 request 相同，例如 `api.delete<Object?>('/pets')`。
  Future<T> delete<T>(String path,
          {Map<String, dynamic>? query, Object? data, DiomanCall? call}) =>
      request<T>('DELETE', path, query: query, data: data, call: call);

  /// 发送 HEAD 并返回数据；参数与 request 相同，例如 `api.head<Object?>('/pets')`。
  Future<T> head<T>(String path,
          {Map<String, dynamic>? query, Object? data, DiomanCall? call}) =>
      request<T>('HEAD', path, query: query, data: data, call: call);

  /// 入口仅 compose 一次；登记后所有可能抛错的构造都在 finally 保护内。
  Future<DiomanResponse<dynamic>> _dispatch(String method, String path,
      {Map<String, dynamic>? query, Object? data, DiomanCall? call}) async {
    _checkAlive();
    final run = _run;
    final site = _debug ? StackTrace.current : null;
    late final DiomanContextState state;
    state = DiomanContextState(CancelToken(),
        onDispose: () => _cancellable.remove(state));
    _cancellable.add(state);
    DiomanCancelLink? userLink;
    _pending.add(state);
    try {
      final c = call ?? const DiomanCall();
      if (c.cancelToken != null) {
        userLink = DiomanCancelLink(c.cancelToken!, state.cancel);
      }
      final options = Options(
              method: method,
              headers: c.headers,
              sendTimeout: c.sendTimeout,
              receiveTimeout: c.receiveTimeout)
          .compose(dio.options, path, queryParameters: query, data: data);
      if (c.connectTimeout != null) options.connectTimeout = c.connectTimeout;
      final ctx = DiomanContextInternal.create<R>(
          id: ++_sequence,
          client: this,
          request: DiomanRequest(options, call: c),
          state: state,
          factory: response,
          keyService: DiomanKeyService(key),
          clock: clock,
          log: _log);
      var result = await run(ctx);
      if (result.kind != DiomanKind.internal) {
        result = ctx.cancelled() ?? result;
      }
      if (!result.ok && site != null && result.kind != DiomanKind.internal) {
        result = response.withCallSite(result, site);
      }
      if (result.kind == DiomanKind.internal) {
        Error.throwWithStackTrace(
            result.error ?? StateError('internal result without error'),
            result.errorStack ?? StackTrace.current);
      }
      return result;
    } finally {
      userLink?.dispose();
      state.dispose();
      _pending.remove(state);
    }
  }
}

/// 内核状态访问与白盒诊断；不从公共入口导出。
extension DiomanContextInternal<R extends DiomanResponse<dynamic>>
    on DiomanContext<R> {
  /// 当前逻辑请求共享状态，仅内核与内置插件可依赖。
  DiomanContextState get state => _state;

  /// 残留的取消等待订阅数，供 I3 白盒断言。
  int get cancellationSubscriptions => _state.listeners.length;

  /// 为内核及白盒夹具创建带共享状态的上下文。
  static DiomanContext<T> create<T extends DiomanResponse<dynamic>>(
          {required int id,
          required Dioman<T> client,
          required DiomanRequest request,
          required DiomanContextState state,
          required DiomanResponseFactory<T> factory,
          required DiomanKeyService keyService,
          required DiomanClock clock,
          required DiomanLogger log}) =>
      DiomanContext<T>._internal(
          id: id,
          client: client,
          request: request,
          state: state,
          factory: factory,
          keyService: keyService,
          clock: clock,
          log: log);
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:dioman/dioman.dart';

import 'scenarios.dart';

/// 基线请求的绝对地址，不产生真实网络访问。
const _baseUrl = 'https://benchmark.invalid';

/// 所有场景共用的路径。
const _path = '/value';

/// 立即返回的成功信封；每次 fetch 新建响应，Dio 每次解码出新 Map。
const _envelope = '{"code":0,"data":{"value":1},"message":"ok"}';

/// 薄假传输，只计数并返回新信封，没有路由表或定时器。
class _ImmediateAdapter implements HttpClientAdapter {
  /// 记录实际传输调用数。
  int sends = 0;

  /// 立即创建独立响应体，交给真实 Dio Transformer 解码。
  @override
  Future<ResponseBody> fetch(RequestOptions options,
      Stream<Uint8List>? requestStream, Future<void>? cancelFuture) async {
    sends++;
    return ResponseBody.fromString(_envelope, 200, headers: {
      Headers.contentTypeHeader: [Headers.jsonContentType]
    });
  }

  /// 假传输没有需要释放的连接。
  @override
  void close({bool force = false}) {}
}

/// 有效凭证，基准不触发刷新。
class _Tokens implements DiomanTokenManager {
  @override
  String get accessToken => 'benchmark-token';
  @override
  String get refreshToken => 'benchmark-refresh';
  @override
  void setTokens({required String accessToken, String? refreshToken}) {}
  @override
  void clear() {}
}

/// 新客户端六场景，与固定旧提交共享 runner 和发送数自检。
class _PipelineClient implements DiomanBenchClient {
  _PipelineClient(this.scenario) {
    dio.httpClientAdapter = adapter;
    final full = scenario == DiomanBenchScenario.s3 ||
        scenario == DiomanBenchScenario.s4;
    final shared = scenario == DiomanBenchScenario.s5;
    api = Dioman(dio: dio, plugins: [
      if (full) ...[
        const DiomanEnvs([]),
        DiomanTimeout(probe: () => NetworkQuality.excellent),
        const DiomanRepath(),
        const DiomanFilter(),
        const DiomanCache(expires: Duration(hours: 1)),
        DiomanOffline(
            isOnline: () => true, onConnectivityChanged: connectivity.stream),
        DiomanLoading(onChanged: (_) {}),
        DiomanAuth(
            tokenManager: _Tokens(),
            onRefresh: (_, __) {},
            onAccessExpired: (_, __) {}),
        const DiomanBreaker(),
        DiomanNotify(notify: (_, __) {}),
        // 空路由代表不命中；不额外发 mock 探测请求。
        const DiomanMock(),
      ],
      if (full || shared) const DiomanShare(policy: DiomanSharePolicy.start),
      if (full || scenario == DiomanBenchScenario.s6) const DiomanRetry(max: 2),
    ]);
  }
  final DiomanBenchScenario scenario;
  final dio = Dio(BaseOptions(baseUrl: _baseUrl));
  final adapter = _ImmediateAdapter();
  final connectivity = StreamController<bool>.broadcast();
  late final Dioman api;
  int sequence = 0;
  @override
  int get sends => adapter.sends;
  @override
  Future<void> operation() async {
    if (scenario == DiomanBenchScenario.s1) {
      await dio.get<dynamic>(_path);
    } else if (scenario == DiomanBenchScenario.s5) {
      await Future.wait(List.generate(
          diomanBenchConcurrency,
          (_) => api.get<dynamic>(_path,
              call: DiomanCall(options: {DiomanShare.option: true}))));
    } else if (scenario == DiomanBenchScenario.s6) {
      await api.post<dynamic>(_path, data: {
        'items': [
          {'value': 1}
        ]
      });
    } else {
      await api.get<dynamic>(_path,
          query: scenario == DiomanBenchScenario.s3
              ? {'sequence': sequence++}
              : null,
          call: DiomanCall(
              options: {DiomanCache.option: true, DiomanShare.option: true}));
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> dispose() async {
    api.dispose();
    dio.close(force: true);
    await connectivity.close();
  }
}

Future<DiomanBenchClient> createPipelineBenchClient(
        DiomanBenchScenario scenario) async =>
    _PipelineClient(scenario);

stdout 仅输出和新版 runner 相同的 JSON；git/pub 日志写 stderr。
"""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import uuid

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
REVISION = '895d959'


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--out', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    temporary = ROOT / ('.bench-legacy-' + uuid.uuid4().hex)
    dart = shutil.which('dart')
    if not dart:
        raise RuntimeError('dart unavailable')
    added = False
    try:
        subprocess.run(['git', 'worktree', 'add', '--detach', str(temporary), REVISION],
                       cwd=ROOT, check=True, stdout=sys.stderr)
        added = True
        package = temporary / 'dioman'
        subprocess.run([dart, 'pub', 'get', '--offline'], cwd=package,
                       check=True, stdout=sys.stderr)
        result = subprocess.run([dart, 'run', 'benchmark/legacy.dart'],
                                cwd=package, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
        sys.stderr.write(result.stderr)
        data = json.loads(result.stdout.strip())
        data['implementation'] = 'legacy-' + REVISION
        output = json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n'
        if args.out:
            args.out.write_text(output, encoding='utf-8')
        else:
            sys.stdout.write(output)
    finally:
        if added:
            assert temporary.resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT) and temporary.name.startswith('.bench-legacy-')
            subprocess.run(['git', 'worktree', 'remove', '--force', str(temporary)],
                           cwd=ROOT, check=True, stdout=sys.stderr)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

    final server = await HttpServer.bind(InternetAddress.loopbackIPv4, 0);
    server.listen((request) async {
      final match = RegExp(r'^/todos/(\d+)$').firstMatch(request.uri.path);

        'example/real_run.dart',
      ]);
      expect(result.exitCode, 0, reason: '${result.stdout}\n${result.stderr}');
      expect(result.stdout, contains('ALL CHECKS PASSED'));

import 'dart:async';
import '../client.dart';
import '../context.dart';
import '../options.dart';
import '../plugin.dart';
import '../request.dart';
import '../response.dart';
import '../stages.dart';

/// 鉴权失败后的处理动作。
enum DiomanAuthFailureAction {
  /// 加入或发起单飞刷新。
  refresh,

  /// 用当前凭证直接重放。
  replay,

  /// 通知访问拒绝。
  deny,

  /// 结束失败请求所属会话。
  expired,

  /// 原样返回，与鉴权无关。
  others,
}

/// 通知回调，异常隔离；接收存储与失败结果。
typedef DiomanAuthNotice = FutureOr<void> Function(
    DiomanTokenManager tokens, DiomanResponse<dynamic> result);

/// 刷新回调自行调用 setTokens；同步与异步异常均算刷新失败。
typedef DiomanAuthRefresh = FutureOr<void> Function(
    DiomanTokenManager tokens, DiomanResponse<dynamic> result);

/// 判定回调，异常按程序错误落定。
typedef DiomanAuthFailure = FutureOr<DiomanAuthFailureAction> Function(
    DiomanResponse<dynamic> result, DiomanTokenManager tokens);

/// 返回注入补丁；回调需使用传入存储的当前原始凭证。
typedef DiomanAuthReady = FutureOr<RequestPatch> Function(
    DiomanTokenManager tokens, DiomanRequest request);

/// 默认按逻辑状态判定；[injectedToken] 是最后一次调用 ready 前的凭证快照。
/// 例如旧请求携带 a、当前为 b 时返回 replay，保留新会话。
DiomanAuthFailureAction defaultAuthFailure(DiomanResponse<dynamic> result,
    DiomanTokenManager tokens, String? injectedToken) {
  if (result.status == 403) return DiomanAuthFailureAction.deny;
  if (result.status != 401) return DiomanAuthFailureAction.others;
  final current = tokens.accessToken;
  if (current == null || current.isEmpty) {
    return DiomanAuthFailureAction.expired;
  }
  return injectedToken != current
      ? DiomanAuthFailureAction.replay
      : DiomanAuthFailureAction.refresh;
}

/// 请求级覆盖；null 字段继承插件配置。
class DiomanAuthOptions {
  /// 设置本次请求的鉴权选项，例如 `DiomanAuthOptions(enabled: false)`。
  const DiomanAuthOptions(
      {this.enabled,
      this.onAccessDenied,
      this.onAccessExpired,
      this.onFailure,
      this.isProtected,
      this.ready,
      this.expiresAt,
      this.refreshLeeway,
      this.headerKey,
      this.buildHeader});

  /// true 强制保护、false 公开；null 使用 isProtected。
  final bool? enabled;

  /// 本地拒绝与服务端拒绝通知；缺省回退过期通知。
  final DiomanAuthNotice? onAccessDenied;

  /// 会话过期通知；同一失败会话只通知一次。
  final DiomanAuthNotice? onAccessExpired;

  /// 异步失败路由；internal 与 cancel 不参与。
  final DiomanAuthFailure? onFailure;

  /// 每次尝试入口判定一次是否保护。
  final bool Function(DiomanRequest request)? isProtected;

  /// 异步生成凭证补丁；凭证变化时最多重做三次。
  final DiomanAuthReady? ready;

  /// 读取凭证过期时间，null 不主动刷新。
  final DateTime? Function(String token)? expiresAt;

  /// 过期提前量。
  final Duration? refreshLeeway;

  /// 默认注入的请求头名称。
  final String? headerKey;

  /// 格式化原始凭证。
  final String Function(String token)? buildHeader;
}

/// 凭证注入、会话判定与每客户端单飞刷新。
class DiomanAuth<R extends DiomanResponse<dynamic>> extends DiomanPlugin<R> {
  /// onRefresh 写入新凭证；抛错算刷新失败，通知回调抛错不改变结果。
  /// 示例：`DiomanAuth(tokenManager: store, onRefresh: refresh, onAccessExpired: logout)`。
  const DiomanAuth(
      {required this.tokenManager,
      required this.onRefresh,
      this.enabled = true,
      this.onAccessDenied,
      required this.onAccessExpired,
      this.onFailure,
      this.isProtected,
      this.ready,
      this.expiresAt,
      this.refreshLeeway = Duration.zero,
      this.headerKey = 'Authorization',
      this.buildHeader = defaultBuildHeader});

  /// 凭证存储，由调用方持有。
  final DiomanTokenManager tokenManager;

  /// 刷新操作独立于调用方取消。
  final DiomanAuthRefresh onRefresh;

  /// 安装或请求级开关。
  @override
  final bool enabled;

  /// 本地拒绝与服务端拒绝通知；缺省回退过期通知。
  final DiomanAuthNotice? onAccessDenied;

  /// 会话过期通知；同一失败会话只通知一次。
  final DiomanAuthNotice onAccessExpired;

  /// 异步失败路由；internal 与 cancel 不参与。
  final DiomanAuthFailure? onFailure;

  /// 每次尝试入口判定一次是否保护。
  final bool Function(DiomanRequest request)? isProtected;

  /// 异步生成凭证补丁；凭证变化时最多重做三次。
  final DiomanAuthReady? ready;

  /// 读取凭证过期时间，null 不主动刷新。
  final DateTime? Function(String token)? expiresAt;

  /// 过期提前量。
  final Duration refreshLeeway;

  /// 默认注入的请求头名称。
  final String headerKey;

  /// 格式化原始凭证。
  final String Function(String token) buildHeader;

  /// ready 稳定化最多执行次数；超过就以最后一次为准，避免无限追赶。
  static const readyStableAttempts = 3;

  /// 稳定名称。
  static const pluginName = 'dioman:auth';

  /// 请求级选项键，支持 bool 与 DiomanAuthOptions。
  static final option = DiomanOptionKey<DiomanAuthOptions>(pluginName);

  /// 实际注入凭证状态；用于自定义探针，不通过请求头反推。
  static final injectedToken = StateKey<String?>('auth.injectedToken');

  /// 默认 Bearer 格式。
  static String defaultBuildHeader(String token) => 'Bearer $token';

  /// 固定名称。
  @override
  String get name => pluginName;

  /// 凭证阶段。
  @override
  DiomanStage get stage => DiomanStage.credential;

  /// 每次安装新建刷新窗口与过期标记。
  @override
  DiomanPluginInstance<R> setup(Dioman<R> client) => _Auth<R>(
      this,
      DiomanAuthOptions(
          onAccessDenied: onAccessDenied,
          onAccessExpired: onAccessExpired,
  final dio = Dio(BaseOptions(baseUrl: _literalHttpsApiDemoDev));
  dio.httpClientAdapter = mock;
  final api = Dioman(dio: dio, plugins: [DiomanRepath(), _logPlugin(emit)]);

  emit('GET "/users/{id}"  queryParams: {id:42, q:"", page:1}', _Kind.system);

// 4. key ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Future<void> _runKey(_Emit emit) async {
  emit(
      'DiomanKey normalises "METHOD:path?sorted-params" — param order is irrelevant.',
      _Kind.system);

  int hits = 0;
  final mock = _FakeServer()
    ..add('GET:/items', (_) async {
      hits++;
      return _json('[1,2,3]');
    });

  final dio = Dio(BaseOptions(baseUrl: _literalHttpsApiDemoDev));
  dio.httpClientAdapter = mock;
  final api = Dioman(
      dio: dio,
      plugins: [DiomanCache(persist: _MemCachePersist()), _logPlugin(emit)]);

  emit('① GET /items?sort=asc&page=1', _Kind.system);
  await api.send<dynamic>(
      _literalGET,
      call: _sourceCall,
      _literalItems,
      query: {_literalSort: _literalAsc, _literalPage: 1});
  emit('   server hits: $hits', _Kind.system);

  emit('② GET /items?page=1&sort=asc  (same params, swapped order)',
      _Kind.system);
  await api.send<dynamic>(
      _literalGET,
      call: _sourceCall,
      _literalItems,
      query: {_literalPage: 1, _literalSort: _literalAsc});
  emit('   server hits: $hits  ← cache hit, same key', _Kind.response);

  emit('③ GET /items?page=2&sort=asc  (different value)', _Kind.system);
  await api.send<dynamic>(
      _literalGET,
      call: _sourceCall,
      _literalItems,
      query: {_literalPage: 2, _literalSort: _literalAsc});
  emit('   server hits: $hits  ← different key, new request', _Kind.response);
}

// 5. normalize ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Future<void> _runNormalize(_Emit emit) async {
  final mock = _FakeServer()
    ..add(
        _literalGETUsers1,
        (_) async =>
            _json('{"code":0,"data":{"id":1,"name":"Alice"},"message":"ok"}'))
    ..add(
        'GET:/users/2',
        (_) async =>
            _json('{"code":10001,"data":null,"message":"User not found"}'));

  // ── success: envelope unwrapped
  {
    final dio = Dio(BaseOptions(baseUrl: _literalHttpsApiDemoDev));
    dio.httpClientAdapter = mock;
    final api = Dioman(dio: dio, plugins: [_logPlugin(emit)]);

    emit('response: {"code":0,"data":{...},"message":"ok"}', _Kind.system);
    final res =
        await api.send<dynamic>(_literalGET, call: _sourceCall, _literalUsers1);
    emit('res.data (unwrapped): ${jsonEncode(res.data)}', _Kind.response);
  }

  // ── failure: non-zero code → DiomanException
  {
    final dio = Dio(BaseOptions(baseUrl: _literalHttpsApiDemoDev));
    dio.httpClientAdapter = mock;
    final api = Dioman(dio: dio, plugins: [_logPlugin(emit)]);

    emit('response: {"code":10001,"data":null,"message":"User not found"}',
        _Kind.system);
    try {
      await api.request<dynamic>(_literalGET, call: _sourceCall, '/users/2');
    } on DiomanResponse catch (e) {
      emit('${e.kind.name} ${e.status}: ${e.message}', _Kind.error);
    }
  }

  final mock = _FakeServer()
    ..add(_literalGETUsers1, (_) async {
      hits++;

  final t1 = Stopwatch()..start();
  await api.send<dynamic>(_literalGET, call: _sourceCall, _literalUsers1);
  t1.stop();
  emit('   server hits: $hits   ${t1.elapsedMilliseconds} ms', _Kind.system);

  emit('2nd GET /users/1  (same key → cache)', _Kind.system);
  final t2 = Stopwatch()..start();
  final r2 =
      await api.send<dynamic>(_literalGET, call: _sourceCall, _literalUsers1);
  t2.stop();
  emit(
    '   server hits: $hits   ${t2.elapsedMilliseconds} ms'
    '   statusMessage: "${r2.message}"',
    _Kind.response,
  );
}

// 7. share ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Future<void> _runDedup(_Emit emit) async {

  final mock = _FakeServer()
    ..add('GET:/users/7', (_) async {
      hits++;

    });

  final dio = Dio(BaseOptions(baseUrl: _literalHttpsApiDemoDev));
  dio.httpClientAdapter = mock;
  final api = Dioman(dio: dio, plugins: [DiomanShare(), _logPlugin(emit)]);

  emit('fire 3× GET /users/7 concurrently…', _Kind.system);
  final sw = Stopwatch()..start();
  final results = await Future.wait([
    api.send<dynamic>(_literalGET, call: _sourceCall, _literalUsers7),
    api.send<dynamic>(_literalGET, call: _sourceCall, _literalUsers7),
    api.send<dynamic>(_literalGET, call: _sourceCall, _literalUsers7),
  ]);
  sw.stop();
  emit(
    '${results.length} callers resolved · $hits HTTP call · ${sw.elapsedMilliseconds} ms',
    _Kind.response,
  );
}

Future<void> _runMock(_Emit emit) async {
  final dio = Dio(BaseOptions(baseUrl: _literalHttpsApiDemoDev));
  final api = Dioman(dio: dio, plugins: [
    DiomanMock(routes: {
      'GET:/pets': (_) => [
            {_literalId: 1, _literalName: 'Whiskers'},
            {_literalId: 2, _literalName: 'Buddy'}
          ],
      'POST:/pets': (request) => {
            _literalId: 3,
            _literalName: (request.data as Map)[_literalName],
            'created': true
          },
      'DELETE:/pets/1': (request) => Response<dynamic>(
          requestOptions: RequestOptions(path: request.path), statusCode: 204),
    }),
    _logPlugin(emit),
  ]);

  emit('3 routes registered: GET /pets · POST /pets · DELETE /pets/1',
      _Kind.system);

  final list =
      await api.send<dynamic>(_literalGET, call: _sourceCall, _literalPets);
  emit('GET   /pets              → ${list.data}', _Kind.response);

  final created = await api
      .send<dynamic>('POST', _literalPets, data: {_literalName: 'Luna'});
  emit('POST  /pets {name:Luna}  → ${created.data}', _Kind.response);

  final del = await api.send<dynamic>('DELETE', '/pets/1');
  emit('DELETE /pets/1           → ${del.status} No Content', _Kind.response);
}

// 9. cancel ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Future<void> _runCancel(_Emit emit) async {
  int done = 0, aborted = 0;

  Future<ResponseBody> slowHandler(RequestOptions opts, String tag) async {
    for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 100));
      if (opts.cancelToken?.isCancelled ?? false) {
        throw DioException(
          requestOptions: opts,
          type: DioExceptionType.cancel,
          message: 'cancelled by cancelAll()',
        );
      }
    }
    done++;
    return _json('{"tag":"$tag"}');
  }

  final mock = _FakeServer()
    ..add('GET:/slow/a', (o) => slowHandler(o, 'a'))
    ..add('GET:/slow/b', (o) => slowHandler(o, 'b'))
    ..add('GET:/slow/c', (o) => slowHandler(o, 'c'));

  final dio = Dio(BaseOptions(baseUrl: _literalHttpsApiDemoDev));
  dio.httpClientAdapter = mock;
  final api = Dioman(dio: dio, plugins: [_logPlugin(emit)]);

  emit('fire 3 slow requests (500 ms each)…', _Kind.system);

  Future<void> fire(String path, int n) async {
    try {
      await api.request<dynamic>(_literalGET, call: _sourceCall, path);
    } on DiomanResponse catch (e) {
      if (e.kind == DiomanKind.cancel) {
        aborted++;
        emit('  request $n cancelled ✗', _Kind.error);
      }
    }
  }

  final all =
      Future.wait([fire('/slow/a', 1), fire('/slow/b', 2), fire('/slow/c', 3)]);

  await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 150));
  emit('cancelAll() — simulating page navigation', _Kind.system);
  api.cancelAll('left page');

  await all;
  emit('cancelled: $aborted · completed: $done', _Kind.system);
}

// 10. loading ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Future<void> _runLoading(_Emit emit) async {
  int counter = 0;

  final mock = _FakeServer()
    ..add('GET:/task/a', (_) async {
      await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 200));
      return _json('{"task":"a"}');
    })
    ..add('GET:/task/b', (_) async {
      await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 320));
      return _json('{"task":"b"}');
    })
    ..add('GET:/task/c', (_) async {
      await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 260));
      return _json('{"task":"c"}');
    });

  final dio = Dio(BaseOptions(baseUrl: _literalHttpsApiDemoDev));
  dio.httpClientAdapter = mock;
  final api = Dioman(dio: dio, plugins: [
    DiomanLoading(onChanged: (on) {
      counter += on ? 1 : -1;
      emit('counter = $counter  (${on ? "+1" : "−1"})', _Kind.system);
    }),
    _logPlugin(emit),
  ]);

  emit('fire 3 concurrent requests (/task/a · /task/b · /task/c)…',
      _Kind.system);
  await Future.wait([
    api.send<dynamic>(_literalGET, call: _sourceCall, '/task/a'),
    api.send<dynamic>(_literalGET, call: _sourceCall, '/task/b'),
    api.send<dynamic>(_literalGET, call: _sourceCall, '/task/c'),
  ]);
  emit('all done  counter = $counter', _Kind.response);
}

import 'package:dio/dio.dart';

/// 以请求覆盖值 [override] 替换 [base]，适合没有字段合并的标量选项。
/// 例如 `resolveOption<int>(2, base: 1, merge: replaceOption)` 返回 2。
T replaceOption<T>(T base, T override) => override;

/// 插件请求级选项键；按对象身份隔离，建议使用静态 final 实例。
class DiomanOptionKey<T> {
  /// [description] 仅供调试，例如 `DiomanOptionKey<int>('retry')`。
  DiomanOptionKey(this.description);

  /// 调试说明。
  final String description;
}

/// 解析统一选项；省略/true 复用 [base]，false 关闭；[optIn] 控制省略时关闭。
/// [merge] 合并类型化覆盖，[shorthand] 返回简写解析值；未知类型抛 ArgumentError。
/// 示例：`resolveOption<int>(true, base: 3, merge: (a, b) => b)`。
T? resolveOption<T>(Object? value,
    {required T base,
    required T Function(T base, T override) merge,
    T? Function(Object value)? shorthand,
    bool optIn = false}) {
  if (value == false || (value == null && optIn)) return null;
  if (value == null || value == true) return base;
  if (value is T) return merge(base, value as T);
  final short = shorthand?.call(value);
  if (short != null) return merge(base, short);
  throw ArgumentError.value(value, 'value', '不支持的插件选项');
}

/// 一次逻辑调用的配置；省略字段沿用 Dio 或客户端配置。

  /// 创建调用配置，例如 `DiomanCall(key: false, envelope: false)`。

      {this.headers,
      this.connectTimeout,
      this.sendTimeout,
      this.receiveTimeout,
      this.cancelToken,
      this.key,
      this.envelope,
      this.silent = false,
      this.options = const {}});

  /// 按不区分大小写的键覆盖请求头。
  final Map<String, dynamic>? headers;

  /// 连接超时。
  final Duration? connectTimeout;

  /// 发送超时。
  final Duration? sendTimeout;

  /// 接收超时。
  final Duration? receiveTimeout;

  /// 用户取消令牌。
  final CancelToken? cancelToken;

  /// String、false 或 DiomanKeyOptions；null 为自动计算。
  final Object? key;

  /// false 禁用本次信封识别。
  final bool? envelope;

  /// 是否静默通知。
  final bool silent;

  /// 插件的类型化请求级选项。
  final Map<DiomanOptionKey, Object?> options;
}
      this.clone = DiomanClonePolicy.shallow,
      this.clock,
      this.shouldCache,
      this.shouldStore,
      this.enabled = true});

  /// 内存 LRU 上限，非正数不限；请求级不支持覆盖。
  final int maxEntries;

  /// 可选持久化存储；persist/both 策略要求提供。
  final DiomanCachePersist? persist;

  /// 默认存储层。
  final DiomanCachePolicy cachePolicy;

  /// 默认有效期。
  final Duration expires;

  /// 默认克隆策略或自定义函数。
  final Object clone;

  final bool Function(DiomanResponse<dynamic>)? shouldStore;

  final DiomanClock? clock;

  static const pluginName = 'dioman:cache';

  static final option = DiomanOptionKey<DiomanCacheOptions>(pluginName);

  /// 名称。
  @override
  String get name => pluginName;

  /// 结果来源阶段。
  @override
  DiomanStage get stage => DiomanStage.source;

  /// 状态按客户端隔离，时钟统一使用客户端时钟。
  @override
  DiomanPluginInstance<R> setup(Dioman<R> client) => _Cache<R>(
      persist,
      maxEntries,
      clock ?? client.clock,
      DiomanCacheOptions(
          cachePolicy: cachePolicy,
          expires: expires,
          clone: clone,
          shouldCache: shouldCache,
          shouldStore: shouldStore));

// ignore_for_file: avoid_print
import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:dioman/dioman.dart';
import 'lib/token_manager.dart';
export 'lib/token_manager.dart';

/// 文件内共用的字面量。
const _literalRefreshToken = "refreshToken";

/// 构造洋葱客户端；调用方负责 dispose 并关闭 Dio。
Dioman createHttp({
  String baseUrl = 'https://api.example.com',
  Duration connectTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 15),
  Duration receiveTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 15),
  required DiomanTokenManager tokenManager,
  void Function(bool loading)? onLoading,
  Future<void> Function()? onSessionExpired,
  bool enableMock = false,
  String? mockUrl,
  int retryMax = 2,
}) {
  return Dioman(
      dio: Dio(BaseOptions(
          baseUrl: baseUrl,
          connectTimeout: connectTimeout,
          receiveTimeout: receiveTimeout)),
      plugins: [
        const DiomanRepath(),
        const DiomanFilter(),
        const DiomanCache(),
        const DiomanShare(),
        DiomanRetry(max: retryMax),
        if (enableMock) DiomanMock(mockUrl: mockUrl),
        DiomanLoading(onChanged: onLoading ?? (_) {}),
        DiomanAuth(
            tokenManager: tokenManager,
            isProtected: (request) => !request.path.contains('/auth/'),
            onRefresh: (tokens, _) async {
              final refresh = Dioman(dio: Dio(BaseOptions(baseUrl: baseUrl)));
              try {
                final data = await refresh.post<Map<String, dynamic>>(
                    '/auth/refresh-token',
                    data: {_literalRefreshToken: tokens.refreshToken});
                tokens.setTokens(
                    accessToken: data['accessToken'] as String,
                    refreshToken: data[_literalRefreshToken] as String?);
              } finally {
                refresh.dispose();
                refresh.dio.close(force: true);
              }
            },
            onAccessExpired: (_, __) async => onSessionExpired?.call()),
      ]);
}

/// 普通请求抛出归一化失败；send 可直接读取结果。
Future<void> main() async {
  final api =
      createHttp(tokenManager: InMemoryTokenManager(access: 'demo-access'));
  try {
    final user = await api.get<dynamic>('/users/{id}',
        query: {'id': 42, 'q': ''},
        call: DiomanCall(
            options: {DiomanCache.option: true, DiomanShare.option: true}));
    print(user);
    final result = await api.send<dynamic>('GET', '/public/config',
        call: DiomanCall(
            options: {DiomanAuth.option: false, DiomanLoading.option: false}));
    print('${result.kind.name}: ${result.data}');
  } on DiomanResponse catch (failure) {
    print('${failure.kind.name}: ${failure.message}');
  } finally {
    api.cancelAll();
    api.dispose();
    api.dio.close(force: true);
  }
}

/// debug 日志回调；关闭 debug 时不会调用。
typedef DiomanLogger = void Function(String message);

/// 生命周期收尾的取消结果覆盖；离线销毁须保留 disposed 原因。
final cancellationFailure = StateKey<DiomanFailure>('cancellation outcome');

/// 逻辑请求状态键；使用非 const 实例保证按身份隔离。
final class StateKey<T> {
  /// 创建键，例如 `final attempt = StateKey<int>('attempt')`。
  const StateKey(this.description);

  /// 调试说明。
  final String description;
}

/// 每层的固定形状上下文；派生请求共享逻辑状态。
class DiomanContext<R extends DiomanResponse<dynamic>> {
  /// 注入内核服务；例如测试可直接构造而不发起请求。
  DiomanContext(
      {required this.id,
      required this.client,
      required this.request,
      required this.factory,
      required this.keyService,
      required this.clock,
      required this.log})
      : _state = DiomanContextState(CancelToken());

  /// 内核注入共享状态，公开构造器不接受内部类型。
  DiomanContext._internal(
      {required this.id,
      required this.client,
      required this.request,
      required DiomanContextState state,
      required this.factory,
      required this.keyService,
      required this.clock,
      required this.log})
      : _state = state;

  /// 请求序号。
  final int id;

  /// 所属客户端。
  final Dioman<R> client;

  /// 本层请求视图。
  final DiomanRequest request;

  /// 共享状态。
  final DiomanContextState _state;

  /// 结果服务。
  final DiomanResponseFactory<R> factory;

  /// 构键服务。
  final DiomanKeyService keyService;

  /// 注入时钟。
  final DiomanClock clock;

  /// 受 debug 开关控制的日志器。
  final DiomanLogger log;

  /// 当前传输的取消令牌，补丁可以覆盖。
  CancelToken get cancelToken => request.cancelToken ?? state.token;

  /// 逻辑请求或当前传输是否取消。
  bool get isCancelled => cancelToken.isCancelled;

  /// 是否保护重放请求体。
  bool get replayable => state.replayable;

  /// 惰性构键并按请求身份缓存；false 选项返回 null。
  String? key() {
    if (!state.keys.containsKey(request)) {
      state.keys[request] =
          keyService.build(request.toRequestOptions(), request.call.key);
    }
    return state.keys[request];
  }

  /// 读取 [key] 的类型化值，未设置返回 null。
  T? get<T>(StateKey<T> key) => state.values?[key] as T?;

  /// 写入 [key] 的类型化 [value]，各层共享。
  void set<T>(StateKey<T> key, T value) => (state.values ??= {})[key] = value;

  /// 经工厂生成结果；坏扩展工厂回退基础 internal，以保证 next 不抛错。
  DiomanResponse<dynamic> fail(DiomanFailure failure) =>
      factory.fail(request, failure);

  /// 声明可能重放；后续每次发送均独立克隆请求体。
  void markReplayable() => state.replayable = true;

  /// 已取消则造 cancel 结果，否则返回 null；每次 await 后应调用。
  DiomanResponse<dynamic>? cancelled() => isCancelled
      ? fail(get(cancellationFailure) ??
          const DiomanFailure(kind: DiomanKind.cancel))
      : null;

  /// 派生请求视图，保留所有逻辑服务与共享状态。
  DiomanContext<R> derive(RequestPatch patch) => DiomanContext._internal(
      id: id,
      client: client,
      request: request.patch(patch),
      state: state,
      factory: factory,
      keyService: keyService,
      clock: clock,
      log: log);

  /// 等待 [pending]、取消或 [timeout]；后两者返回 null，结束后无订阅及计时器。
  /// 已取消立即返回；迟到的值或异常被消费且不会改变结局。
  Future<T?> wait<T>(Future<T> pending, {Duration? timeout}) {
    final result = Completer<T?>();
    Timer? timer;
    DiomanCancelLink? localLink;
    late void Function() cancel;
    void clean() {
      timer?.cancel();
      localLink?.dispose();
      state.listeners.remove(cancel);
    }

    void finish(T? value) {
      if (result.isCompleted) return;
      clean();
      result.complete(value);
    }

    cancel = () => finish(null);
    // 即使已经取消，也消费输入的迟到异常。
    pending.then((value) => finish(value),
        onError: (Object error, StackTrace stack) {
      if (result.isCompleted) return;
      clean();
      result.completeError(error, stack);
    });
    if (isCancelled) {
      finish(null);
      return result.future;
    }
    state.listeners[cancel] = cancelToken;
    if (!identical(cancelToken, state.token)) {
      localLink = DiomanCancelLink(cancelToken, (_) => cancel());
    }
    if (timeout != null) timer = clock.createTimer(timeout, cancel);
    return result.future;
  }
}

/// 封装 ApiEvidence 测试夹具。
/// 公开 API 探针的可追溯证据，只有断言成立才落盘。
class ApiEvidence {
  /// 声明到运行证据的映射。
  final hits = <String, Set<String>>{};

  /// 本次真实服务轮次。
  final run = 'dioman-api-${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}';

  /// 已完成真实请求的证据。
  final observations = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];

  /// mark 的测试实现。
  /// 记录已实际调用或读取的公开符号。
  void mark(Iterable<String> names, String context) {
    for (final name in names) {
      (hits[name] ??= {}).add('$run:$context');
    }
  }

  /// read 的测试实现。
  /// 读取静态字段时保留精确的符号证据。
  void read(String name, Object? value) => mark([name], tkPropertyRead);

  /// constructed 的测试实现。
  /// 为显式传入的构造参数登记证据。
  T constructed<T>(String type, T value, List<String> args) {
    mark([type, '$type.new', for (final a in args) '$type.new($a)'],
        'construct');
    return value;
  }

  /// check 的测试实现。
  /// 校验执行事实，不允许软断言。
  void check(bool valid, String description) {
    if (!valid) throw StateError(description);
  }
}

/// 使用新客户端执行真实请求，只为实际构造和调用登记证据。
Future<ApiEvidence> runApiProbes() async {
  final evidence = ApiEvidence();
  final client = ScenarioClient({
    'client': {'plugins': {}}
  }, evidence.run, serverUrl, tkHttp);
  try {
    final result = await client.api.send<dynamic>('GET', tkTPing,
        call: DiomanCall(headers: client.headers));
    evidence.check(result.ok, '真实 ping 成功');
    evidence.check(client.api.pending == 0, '逻辑请求释放');
    evidence.mark([
      'Dioman',
      'Dioman.new',
      'Dioman.new(dio)',
      'Dioman.send',
      'Dioman.pending',
      'DiomanResponse',
      'DiomanResponse.kind'
    ], '真实 ping');
    evidence.observations
        .add({'kind': result.kind.name, 'status': result.status});
    inspectApiFields(
        evidence, {'Dioman': client.api, 'DiomanResponse': result});
  } finally {
    await client.dispose();
  }
  evidence.mark(['Dioman.dispose'], tkTeardown);
  final target = File(tkAcceptResultsApiEvidenceJson);
  target.parent.createSync(recursive: true);
  target.writeAsStringSync(const JsonEncoder.withIndent(tkJsonIndent).convert({
    tkRunId: evidence.run,
    tkHits: {
      for (final entry in evidence.hits.entries) entry.key: entry.value.toList()
    },
    tkObservations: evidence.observations,
  }));
  return evidence;
}

/// 读取已经实际构造的实例字段；不虚报未构造类型。
Future<void> writeApiEvidence(
        ApiEvidence evidence, Map<String, Object> values) async =>
    inspectApiFields(evidence, values);

/// 由台账生成的逐字段读取入口。
void inspectApiFields(ApiEvidence evidence, Map<String, Object> values) =>
    generatedInspect(evidence, values);

  });

"""核对三轮原始 bench 场景及传输计数，输出报告表格。"""
import json
from pathlib import Path

DIRECTORY = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROUNDS = 3
SCENARIOS = 6
STABILITY_LIMIT = 10


def load_runs():
    """校验正式测量时间与发送次数，拒绝空输出或场景语义失效。"""
    runs = []
    for index in range(1, ROUNDS + 1):
        run = json.loads((DIRECTORY / f'run-{index}.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').strip())
        assert run['mode'] == 'JIT (dart run)'
        assert run['warmupMillis'] >= 500 and run['measurementMillis'] >= 2000
        assert len(run['results']) == SCENARIOS
        for row in run['results']:
            assert row['elapsedSeconds'] >= 2 and row['operations'] > 0
            assert row['sends'] == (0 if row['scenario'] == 'S4' else row['operations'])
            assert row['requestsPerOperation'] == (100 if row['scenario'] == 'S5' else 1)
        runs.append(run)
    return runs


def spread(values):
    """计算三轮相对最小值的最大离散度（百分比）。"""
    return (max(values) / min(values) - 1) * 100


def markdown():
    """输出三轮完整数据与同一吞吐中位轮的指标。"""
    runs = load_runs()
    lines = ['| 场景 | 轮次 | ops/s | 平均 μs/op | p99 μs/op | 操作数 | 测量秒数 | 发送数 |',
             '|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|']
    for scenario in range(SCENARIOS):
        for index, run in enumerate(runs, 1):
            row = run['results'][scenario]
            lines.append(f"| {row['scenario']} | {index} | {row['opsPerSecond']:.2f} | {row['meanMicros']:.3f} | {row['p99Micros']:.3f} | {row['operations']} | {row['elapsedSeconds']:.6f} | {row['sends']} |")
    lines += ['', '| 场景 | 吞吐离散度 | 均值离散度 | p99 离散度 | 吞吐中位轮 | 该轮 ops/s | 该轮平均 μs | 该轮 p99 μs | 吞吐达标 |',
              '|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|']
    for scenario in range(SCENARIOS):
        rows = [run['results'][scenario] for run in runs]
        middle = sorted(range(ROUNDS), key=lambda i: rows[i]['opsPerSecond'])[1]
        row = rows[middle]
        delta = spread([r['opsPerSecond'] for r in rows])
        lines.append(f"| {row['scenario']} | {delta:.2f}% | {spread([r['meanMicros'] for r in rows]):.2f}% | {spread([r['p99Micros'] for r in rows]):.2f}% | {middle + 1} | {row['opsPerSecond']:.2f} | {row['meanMicros']:.3f} | {row['p99Micros']:.3f} | {'是' if delta < STABILITY_LIMIT else '否：只留档'} |")
    return '\n'.join(lines)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(markdown())
    print('\n6 scenarios x 3 processes; elapsed >= 2s; sends/cache/share semantics: PASS')

/// 封装 BrokenReplayForm 测试夹具。
/// 让已发送附件在重试克隆时暴露格式错误，模拟调用方自定义 multipart。
class BrokenReplayForm extends FormData {
  /// clone 的测试实现。
  /// 非状态类错误应通过共享结算传给每个调用者。
  @override
  FormData clone() =>
      throw const FormatException('multipart replay clone failed');
}

/// main 的测试辅助入口。
/// 真实 HTTP/business 双风格确认首发与跟随者都失败、资源释放且没有第二次传输。
Future<void> main() async {
  final session =
      'dioman-share-prepare-${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}-$pid';
  final control = ioClient(netemUrl);
  final server = ioClient(serverUrl);
  final results = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  try {
    for (final style in [tkHttp, tkBusiness]) {
      final run = '$session-$style';
      final proxy = await createProbeProxy(control, run);
      final dio = ioClient('http://127.0.0.1:${proxy[tkPort]}');
      final events = <bool>[];
      final api = Dioman(
          dio: dio,
          key: DiomanKeyOptions(builder: (_) => run),
          plugins: [
            const DiomanShare(policy: DiomanSharePolicy.retry, retries: 1),
            DiomanLoading(onChanged: events.add)
          ]);
      dio.options.headers.addAll({runHeader: run, styleHeader: style});
      try {
        /// 捕获真实失败，避免并发请求产生未处理异常。
        /// attempt 的测试辅助入口。
        Future<FormatException> attempt() async {
          if (serviceBlocked) throw StateError('服务已要求停止验收');
          try {
            await api.post<dynamic>(tkTEcho,
                data: BrokenReplayForm(),
                query: {tkKey: run, tkFailTimes: 1, tkDelayMs: 100});
            throw StateError('预期附件克隆失败，实际成功');
          } on FormatException catch (error) {
            return error;
          }
        }

        final first = attempt();
        // 先等服务端已收到首发，再发跟随者，不依赖客户端调度猜测。
        final deadline = DateTime.now().add(const Duration(seconds: 5));
        while (true) {
          final stats = obj(obj((await server.get<dynamic>('/t/runs/$run',
                  options: Options(headers: {runHeader: run})))
              .data)[tkData]);
          if ((stats[tkTotal] as num? ?? 0) >= 1) break;
          if (DateTime.now().isAfter(deadline)) throw StateError('首发没有真实命中服务');
          await pause(5);
        }
        final errors = await Future.wait([first, attempt()])
            .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5));
        final stats = obj(obj((await server.get<dynamic>('/t/runs/$run',
                options: Options(headers: {runHeader: run})))
            .data)[tkData]);
        if (errors.any(
                (error) => error.message != 'multipart replay clone failed') ||
            stats[tkTotal] != 1 ||
            stats[tkInflight] != 0 ||
            events.where((v) => v).length != events.where((v) => !v).length) {
          throw StateError('share 异常交付或真实传输次数/资源释放不符：$errors/$stats/$events');
        }
        results.add({
          tkRunId: run,
          tkStyle: style,
          tkStatus: tkPassed,
          'errors': errors.map((error) => error.toString()).toList(),
          tkLoading: events,
          tkServer: stats
        });
        stdout.writeln('通过 $run');
      } finally {
        api.dispose();
        dio.close(force: true);
        await deleteProbeProxy(control, proxy, run);
      }
    }
  } finally {
    control.close(force: true);
    server.close(force: true);
    File('coverage/accept/share-prepare-real.json').writeAsStringSync(
        const JsonEncoder.withIndent(tkJsonIndent)
            .convert({tkSession: session, tkResults: results}));
  }
}

  factory MatrixRow.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => MatrixRow(
        id: json[_id] as String,
        plugin: json[_plugin] as String? ?? _core,
        capability: json[_capability] as String? ?? _empty,
        tier: json[_tier] as int?,
        apis: _strings(json[_apis]),
        real: _strings(json[_real]),
        assumptions: _strings(json[_assumptions]),
        result: (json[_result] as Map?)?.cast<String, dynamic>(),
        blocked: json[_blocked] as String?,
        extra: Map.of(json),
      );

  final String id, plugin, capability;
  final int? tier;
  final List<String> apis, real, assumptions;
  final Map<String, dynamic>? result;
  final String? blocked;
  final Map<String, dynamic> extra;

  /// 返回含未知字段的 JSON 对象；例如 `jsonEncode(row.toJson())`。
  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        ...extra,
        _id: id,
        _plugin: plugin,
        _capability: capability,
        _tier: tier,
        _apis: apis,
        _real: real,
        _assumptions: assumptions,
        _result: result,
        _blocked: blocked
      };
}

/// 将可选数组转成字符串列表。

/// 从 [title] 返回方括号中的全部 id；例如 `[A × B][C]` 返回三项。
List<String> parseTitleIds(String title) => [
      for (final match in RegExp(r'\[([^\]]*)\]').allMatches(title))
        ...match[1]!.split('×').map((s) => s.trim()).where((s) => s.isNotEmpty),
    ];

  /// 首发传输脱离首发调用方，最后一个订阅者离开才取消。
  Future<void> run(
      DiomanContext<R> ctx,
      DiomanNext<R> next,
      DiomanShareOptions o,
      Map<String, _Shared> table,
      String key,
      _Shared entry) async {
    final shared = ctx.derive(entry.transportPatch);
    ctx.state.retain();
    try {
      var r = await next(entry.transportPatch);
      if (o.policy == DiomanSharePolicy.retry) {
        for (var i = 0;
            i < o.retries! &&
                !r.ok &&
                r.kind != DiomanKind.internal &&
                !shared.isCancelled;
            i++) {
          if (o.interval! > Duration.zero) {
            await shared.wait(Completer<void>().future, timeout: o.interval);
          }
          if (shared.isCancelled) break;
          r = await next(entry.transportPatch);
        }
      }
      finish(table, key, entry, r);
    } catch (error, stack) {
      finish(
          table,
          key,
          entry,
          ctx.fail(DiomanFailure(
              kind: DiomanKind.internal, error: error, errorStack: stack)));
    } finally {
      ctx.state.release();
    }
  }

  /// end/race 的底层请求各自独立，订阅者离开不会取消其它传输。
  Future<void> compete(
      DiomanContext<R> ctx,
      DiomanNext<R> next,
      DiomanShareOptions o,
      Map<String, _Shared> table,
      String key,
      _Shared entry) async {
    final sequence = ++entry.sequence;
    entry.pending++;
    ctx.state.retain();
    try {
      final r = await next();
      entry.pending--;
      if (o.policy == DiomanSharePolicy.end
          ? sequence == entry.sequence
          : r.ok || entry.pending == 0) {
        finish(table, key, entry, r);
      }
    } finally {
      ctx.state.release();
    }
  }

  /// 解析 optIn 后订阅；wait 自行清理取消监听和计时器。
  @override
  Future<DiomanResponse<dynamic>> handle(
      DiomanContext<R> ctx, DiomanNext<R> next) async {
    final o = resolveOption<DiomanShareOptions>(
        ctx.request.call.options[DiomanShare.option],
        base: base,
        optIn: true,
        shorthand: (v) =>
            v is DiomanSharePolicy ? DiomanShareOptions(policy: v) : null,
        merge: (a, b) => DiomanShareOptions(
            enabled: b.enabled,
            policy: b.policy ?? a.policy,
            retries: b.retries ?? a.retries,
            interval: b.interval ?? a.interval,
            methods: b.methods ?? a.methods));
    if (o == null ||
        o.enabled == false ||
        ctx.get(sourceProbe) == true ||
        !o.methods!.contains(ctx.request.method)) {
      return next();
    }
    final cancel = ctx.cancelled();
    if (cancel != null) return cancel;
    final key = ctx.key();
    if (key == null) return next();
    final table = tables[o.policy]!;
    final existing = table[key];
    final entry = existing ??
    o.headers = h;
    o.queryParameters.removeWhere((k, _) => patch.removeQuery.contains(k));
    o.queryParameters.addAll(patch.query);
    o.extra.addAll(patch.extra);
    if (!identical(patch.data, _absent)) o.data = patch.data;
    if (patch.path != null) o.path = patch.path!;
    if (patch.method != null) o.method = patch.method!;
    if (!identical(patch.connectTimeout, _absent)) {
      o.connectTimeout = patch.connectTimeout as Duration?;
    }
    if (!identical(patch.sendTimeout, _absent)) {
      o.sendTimeout = patch.sendTimeout as Duration?;
    }
    if (!identical(patch.receiveTimeout, _absent)) {
      o.receiveTimeout = patch.receiveTimeout as Duration?;
    }
    if (!identical(patch.cancelToken, _absent)) {
      o.cancelToken = patch.cancelToken as CancelToken?;
    }
    return DiomanRequest(o, call: call);
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'context.dart';
import 'response.dart';

/// 全部 HTTP 状态交给工厂，不让 Dio 构造 badResponse。
bool _acceptStatus(int? _) => true;

/// 递归克隆 JSON 请求体；FormData 使用 Dio 的 clone，其他类型保留身份。
Object? _clone(Object? value, DiomanLogger log) {
  if (value is Map) return value.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, _clone(v, log)));
  if (value is List) return value.map((v) => _clone(v, log)).toList();
  if (value is FormData) return value.clone();
  if (value != null && value is! num && value is! bool && value is! String) {
    log('请求体无法克隆，回退原引用');
  }
  return value;
}

/// 执行一次发送；传输构造、Dio 及工厂异常都在本边界归一化。
Future<DiomanResponse<dynamic>>
    diomanTransport<R extends DiomanResponse<dynamic>>(
        Dio dio, DiomanContext<R> ctx) async {
  try {
    final cancelled = ctx.cancelled();
    if (cancelled != null) return cancelled;
    final options = ctx.request.toRequestOptions()
      ..validateStatus = _acceptStatus
      ..cancelToken = ctx.cancelToken;
    if (ctx.replayable) options.data = _clone(options.data, ctx.log);
    final raw = await dio.fetch<dynamic>(options);
    return ctx.factory
        .normalize(ctx.request, raw: raw, cancelled: ctx.isCancelled);
  } catch (e, s) {
    return ctx.factory
        .normalize(ctx.request, error: e, stack: s, cancelled: ctx.isCancelled);
  }
}

import 'literals.dart';

/// 封装 MemoryPersist 测试夹具。
/// 内存持久化端口，实际缓存行为由插件控制。
class MemoryPersist implements DiomanCachePersist {
  /// 持久化内容。
  final values = <String, dynamic>{};

  /// read 的测试实现。
  /// 读取条目。
  @override
  dynamic read(String key) => values[key];

  /// write 的测试实现。
  /// 写入条目。
  @override
  Future<void> write(String key, Map<String, dynamic> value) async {
    values[key] = value;
  }

  /// remove 的测试实现。
  /// 删除条目。
  @override
  Future<void> remove(String key) async {
    values.remove(key);
  }

  /// erase 的测试实现。
  /// 清空条目。
  @override
  Future<void> erase() async {
    values.clear();
  }
}

/// 封装 Tokens 测试夹具。
/// 令牌存储保留最近一次变化前的值。
class Tokens implements DiomanTokenManager {
  /// 完整鉴权头。
  String? access;

  /// 刷新令牌。
  String? refresh;

  /// 旧鉴权头。
  String? previousAccess;

  /// 旧刷新令牌。
  String? previousRefresh;

  /// 当前用户。
  String user = tkDioman;

  /// accessToken 的测试实现。
  /// 当前令牌。
  @override
  String? get accessToken => access;

  /// refreshToken 的测试实现。
  /// 当前刷新令牌。
  @override
  String? get refreshToken => refresh;

  /// replace 的测试实现。
  /// 更换令牌并记录变化。
  void replace(String? a, String? r) {
    if (a != access) previousAccess = access;
    if (r != refresh) previousRefresh = refresh;
    access = a;
    refresh = r;
  }

  /// accept 的测试实现。
  /// 接收登录或刷新信封数据。
  void accept(Map<String, dynamic> data) => replace(
      data[tkAccessToken] == null ? null : 'Bearer ${data[tkAccessToken]}',
      data[tkRefreshToken] as String?);

  /// 写入刷新后的原始凭证。
  @override
  void setTokens({required String accessToken, String? refreshToken}) =>
      replace(accessToken, refreshToken);

  /// clear 的测试实现。
  /// 清空当前令牌。
  @override
  void clear() => replace(null, null);

  /// mutate 的测试实现。
  /// 按契约篡改令牌。
  void mutate(Map<String, dynamic> spec) {
    final parts = (access ?? tkEmpty).split(tkSpace).last.split(tkDot);
    String? a = access;
    switch (spec[tkAccess]) {
      case tkNone:
        a = null;
      case tkEmpty6:
        a = tkEmpty;
      case tkGarbage:
        a = 'Bearer garbage-not-jwt';
      case tkPrevious:
        a = previousAccess;
      case 'wrong_scheme':
        a = 'Token ${(access ?? tkEmpty).split(tkSpace).last}';
      case 'bad_signature':
        if (parts.length == 3) {
          parts[2] =
              '${parts[2].startsWith(tkA) ? 'B' : tkA}${parts[2].substring(1)}';
        }
        a = 'Bearer ${parts.join(tkDot)}';
      case 'tampered_payload':
        if (parts.length == 3) {
          final payload = obj(jsonDecode(
              utf8.decode(base64Url.decode(base64Url.normalize(parts[1])))));
          payload[tkSub] = '${payload[tkSub]}-tampered';
          parts[1] = base64Url
              .encode(utf8.encode(jsonEncode(payload)))
              .replaceAll(tkEquals, tkEmpty);
        }
        a = 'Bearer ${parts.join(tkDot)}';
    }
    final r = switch (spec[tkRefresh]) {
      tkNone => null,
      tkGarbage => 'garbage-refresh',
      tkPrevious => previousRefresh,
      _ => refresh,
    };
    replace(a, r);
  }
}

  return switch (error.kind) {
